physical_problem.statement: 2D laminar vortex shedding behind a circular cylinder confined in a plane channel (Schaefer & Turek DFG case 2D-2, Re=100). Reported headline defect: C_L amplitude error +35--36%.
physical_problem.geometry: channel x in [0,2.2], y in [0,0.41]; cylinder centre (0.2,0.2), D=0.1; blockage D/H=0.2439

prior_work_acknowledged.what_it_settled: The +36.04% headline (D28) decomposes into ~13.4% of VALUE from an estimator/window defect (D1 peak-pick over the whole record incl. start-up transient + D3 window bookkeeping) and a RESIDUAL +17.75% real error at D28. At D40 the re-judged error is +2.83%.
what_it_left_open: no D>=56 grid level: is the residual real error convergent?
no re-run: conclusions rest on frozen series only
reference band for C_L amplitude traced to in-repo transcription, not the original table (WITHHELD)
prior_work_acknowledged.no_duplication_statement: This mission does NOT re-derive the D1/D3 estimator defect (m16827) and does NOT re-judge the same frozen series for the same purpose. New work: (i) extend the refinement ladder with genuinely new levels D48/D56, (ii) tau/viscosity discriminator at fixed geometry, (iii) geometric blockage audit, (iv) window-length sensitivity of the estimator. Overlap with feature_ledger/knowledge_base/negative_knowledge_ledger checked at start: no existing entry answers these.

external_anchor.primary: Schaefer, M. & Turek, S. (1996) 'Benchmark computations of laminar flow around a cylinder', Notes on Numerical Fluid Mechanics vol. 48, Vieweg, pp. 547-566, case 2D-2, Table 3.
external_anchor.anchor_caveat: Per m16827 the C_L amplitude band 0.99-1.01 is an in-repo transcription; the printed table's primary columns are Cd/dp/St. Treated as WITHHELD-grade traceability, unchanged by this mission. Cd/dp/St bands are unfrozen and independently quoted in the literature.

reproducible_parameters.solver: src/tensorlbm/validation/cylinder_dfg.py::run_case (D2Q9, MRT collision, pull streaming, half-way bounce-back, Ladd momentum exchange, Zou/He inlet+outlet)
reproducible_parameters.lattice_scaling_note: At fixed Re and fixed U_mean, nu_lb = u*D/Re grows with D, hence tau grows (D20:0.550, D28:0.570, D40:0.600, D48:0.620, D56:0.640). Re is exactly preserved at every level; only the discretisation error decreases. This is the correct fixed-Mach/fixed-Re refinement, not a conflation.

D40_u0060.rationale: same geometry/Re, lower U_mean -> tau shifted toward the D28 value; discriminates hypothesis 2 (viscosity/tau model) from hypothesis 1 (grid) at fixed geometry

H1_grid_convergence.statement: The residual C_L amplitude error is a discretisation error that decays with the refinement ladder; the D28->D40 jump is a transient of an under-resolved regime.
H1_grid_convergence.prediction: cl_amp(D48) and cl_amp(D56) sit close to 1.00 and the span |cl_amp(D56)-cl_amp(D48)| / cl_amp(D56) < 3%.
H1_grid_convergence.falsified_if: cl_amp stays >= +10% at BOTH D48 and D56, or the span between the two finest levels is >= 3% (no convergence yet).

H2_turbulence_viscosity_model.statement: The error is caused by the collision/relaxation model: MRT relaxation settings, or tau being inconsistent with Re (compressibility/finite-tau error).
H2_turbulence_viscosity_model.prediction: cl_amp at fixed D40 changes materially (>= 5%) when tau is shifted by lowering U_mean at constant Re.
H2_turbulence_viscosity_model.falsified_if: cl_amp changes < 2% between D40(tau=0.600) and D40(tau=0.572). Note: DFG 2D-2 is a laminar case - no turbulence model is active by definition, so this hypothesis can only be about tau/MRT, which is what is tested.

H3_boundary_distance_blockage.statement: The error comes from the discretised geometry/solid boundary: blockage ratio, cylinder mask area, wall distance, or the DFG pressure-probe placement.
H3_boundary_distance_blockage.prediction: the discretised mask area deviates from pi*D^2/4 by more than ~1%, or an effective blockage different from 0.2439, or the probe extrapolation is off by more than the observed error share.
H3_boundary_distance_blockage.falsified_if: mask area matches pi*D^2/4 within 1% at every level, blockage equals D/H=0.2439, and the probe columns are fluid columns adjacent to the DFG probe positions (inside the stated extrapolation contract).
H3_boundary_distance_blockage.note: Blockage and inlet/outlet distances are FIXED by the benchmark definition and may not be tuned; the test is fidelity to the spec, not sensitivity.

H4_sampling_window.statement: The error is a statistics artifact: start-up transient inside the averaging window, or too short a sampling duration.
H4_sampling_window.prediction: removing the transient and lengthening the averaging window changes the estimate by far more than the tolerance.
H4_sampling_window.falsified_if: on the retained window, cl_amp is stable (drift < 2%) across window lengths 6..12 periods, i.e. 12 periods is already enough.
H4_sampling_window.status_at_freeze: Already measured by m16827 on frozen series: 13.4% of value at D28 is transient contamination, and peak-vs-fundamental contributes a further 1.7%. This mission re-measures it and adds the window-length stability curve; it is NOT expected to be the residual root cause.

quantitative_acceptance.primary_gate: Cl amplitude error < 10% AND dp error < 5% AND Cd error < 5%, SIMULTANEOUSLY, at the finest converged level.
quantitative_acceptance.secondary_gate: convergence span between the two finest levels < 3% for the reported value of each metric.
quantitative_acceptance.tightened_note: The task states <10% for Cl; the case's own frozen tolerance is 5%. Reported against BOTH. The 5% matrix tolerance is NOT relaxed.
quantitative_acceptance.estimator_convention: cl_amp = fundamental (least-squares) amplitude at the shedding frequency over the transient-free window, transient_periods=5, avg_periods=12 (as fixed by m16827); peak-pick median reported alongside for audit only.

decision_rules_predeclared: If primary_gate AND secondary_gate pass at D56 -> the +35% headline is root-caused as (dominant) estimator/window artifact + (residual) under-resolution; case may be re-scored using the finest converged level, and the minimum documented resolution for this case becomes D56.
If primary_gate passes at D56 but secondary_gate fails -> honest FAIL on convergence; status stays failed; root cause = 'no converged level exists below D56'.
If cl_amp remains >= +10% at D56 -> H1 falsified: the residual error is NOT grid convergence. Escalate to a solver-side defect investigation; record honest FAIL with the ladder as evidence.

Thresholds above are frozen. No threshold, window, level, or metric definition may be changed after inspecting the new results. Any deviation must be logged as a deviation with its reason, and the original criterion preserved in the record.

cost_and_resource_plan.local: only analysis of frozen series, geometric audit, figure rendering (<10 min, <8 cores). No heavy solve on the control plane.
cost_and_resource_plan.cluster: D48/D56/D40_u0060 submitted to the scheduler as shards; estimated 900-2700 s each from the measured D40 cost (895 s / 27.2k steps / 144k cells).
cost_and_resource_plan.stopping_rule: no extra levels are added after seeing results unless a predeclared falsification branch requires one; a D64 level would only be considered if the span between D48 and D56 is between 3% and 6% (borderline), and that contingency is declared here in advance.

analysis_plan.aggregation: per-level: Cd, cl_amp, St, dp; error vs band midpoint; convergence span between consecutive levels
analysis_plan.uncertainty: estimator stderr and IQR per level are reported for cl_amp; no outlier removal
analysis_plan.blinding: the estimator and the acceptance gates are code-frozen before the new levels are read; the new levels are scored by the same unchanged code path
analysis_plan.raw_data: docs/m23014/runs/ (record area, not for GitHub) + artifacts committed under benchmarks/verified/cylinder/re100_dfg/artifacts/ as NEW files (existing frozen files never overwritten)

five_level_status_legend.benchmark: measured number against a reference band
five_level_status_legend.production: used in a delivered engineering result

known_limitations_declared_in_advance: C_L amplitude reference band traceability is WITHHELD (in-repo transcription); a pass on it is weaker evidence than a pass on Cd/dp/St.
Lattice-Boltzmann at these resolutions remains a low-order method: absolute 5% agreement on all four quantities at D56 is not guaranteed a priori.
This mission cannot recover the original 1996 table (no network access to the PDF); it will not claim to have verified the band.
